description: Understand where to track Mirror Trading International's three streams of income. Join the official MTI Members News Channel on ...

asr.full_text: Your Bitcoin bonuses in the Mirror Trading International back office. In Mirror Trading International there are three streams of income. Firstly, the bonuses you receive from daily trading. No trading knowledge is required. You join the trading pool with a minimum of $100 of Bitcoin. Your Bitcoin is traded for you from Monday to Friday. Let's look at your back office dashboard. When you look at the trading pool balance, remember the idea of Mirror Trading International is to grow your bitcoin daily, so be sure to look at the bitcoin as it will be compounding daily, meaning that the percentage you earn will be from the new balance at the end of the day and not your original balance. The US dollar value is just an indication and will fluctuate with the Bitcoin price. In your back office trading bonuses, this will show you the Bitcoin you have earned since you joined the trading pool. To view your daily trading result, you can simply click View detailed report or go to the menu on the left, click on the My Bonus report and then Trading bonus report. On this page you will see the results from the daily trades and what you have earned. You can also click on the view button on the right of the actual day to view your statement. The values on statements are expressed in bits. Please note that one bits equals 0.0000001 BTC. To get the Bitcoin value divide your balance by 1 million. Again don't be confused by the U.S. dollar value. Check to make sure your Bitcoin is growing from day to day. The next stream of income from Merit Trading International is the referral bonus. If you refer other people you will get a 10% direct referral bonus. Looking at the back office you will see your income wallet balance. This is the current available bonuses which includes the pending bonuses. Click on the includes pending bonuses to see a detailed report of all the referral bonuses that you have waiting and the time they will be released into your income wallet. When these are released into your wallet you can either withdraw or reinvest into your trading pool. You decide either way but try to get your Bitcoin to work for you, whatever you choose to do. To see what is currently available for transfer or withdrawal from your income wallet go to the internal fund transfer and this will show you your income wallet balance, available income wallet balance, pending income wallet balance and your Pool Account Balance. The third stream of income is the Binary Profit Sharing Bonus. You will need to be binary qualified to earn this bonus. This means you have personally introduced one person on the left and one person on the right of your business. You will also need to have at least $200 in your own position. This will qualify you for the binary bonus and you will receive a weekly binary bonus for your smallest leg. The day you sign up your second person according to the above criteria is the day you will start to benefit from the binary bonuses. Looking at your dashboard in the back office you will see the binary bonuses earned to date and you are also able to click on the see detailed report to give you more information, which will show you the value of your weakest leg and your binary bonus for that week. This bonus will be released into your income wallet, the waiting period for the binary bonuses, just like the referral commissions, is seven days. Finally, looking at all-time total bonuses. This will show you the total of everything that has come to your income wallet to date. In other words, the trading bonuses, referral bonuses and the binary bonuses. For more information please speak to your team leader.

textual.potential_relevance: A promised daily growth/compounding return is linked to transferring at least $100 of Bitcoin into a trading pool.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether trading occurred, whether returns were achieved, or whether funds were lost.

textual.observation: The source describes a 10% direct referral bonus for referring other people, with bonuses becoming available for withdrawal or reinvestment.

evidence.quote: refer other people you will get a 10% direct referral bonus.
When these are released into your wallet you can either withdraw or reinvest into your trading pool.

textual.limitations: The records do not establish the identity or conduct of referred people, payment outcomes, or whether the stated percentage applies in all circumstances.

textual.limitations: The records do not establish the bonus amount, actual payments, or the broader terms governing qualification.

visual.potential_relevance: A monetary bonus is linked to recruiting two people into left and right positions and maintaining at least $200 in the participant's own position, which may merit review of the recruitment and payment structure.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether recruitment occurred, whether bonuses were paid, or the complete terms and conditions.

visual.potential_relevance: Promised referral and binary bonuses are subject to a stated seven-day waiting condition, which may merit review of the conditions attached to receiving the advertised benefits.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show the eventual availability or payment of the pending bonuses.

visual.observation: The presentation explains that users can click “Includes Pending Bonuses” to view upcoming referral bonus information and directs questions to a team leader.
visual.context: On-screen instructional guidance and contact direction within the presentation.
visual.potential_relevance: The audience is directed to use a dashboard control and contact a team leader in connection with pending referral bonuses; the frames do not clarify whether this involves any additional payment, data request, or external destination.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show an actual click, contact exchange, external link, or outcome.

visual_context_notes.observation: The materials visibly identify Mirror Trading International and repeatedly use bitcoin, trading, referral bonus, binary bonus, and dashboard terminology.
A dashboard screenshot visibly displays team-member counts, direct referrals, wallet balances, trading balances, and bonus categories.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a Bitcoin trading pool requiring at least a $100 commitment and claims participants' Bitcoin will grow through daily compounding. It also offers financial rewards for referrals and for maintaining a $200 position while introducing one person on each side of the organization, subject to a waiting period. the available video evidence does not establish that trading occurred, bonuses were paid, or participants experienced a loss.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The video presents three income streams, including a binary bonus that requires recruiting people into left and right legs and pays according to the smaller leg. That recruitment-linked bonus is a central part of the back-office walkthrough. The separate trading-pool offer links a Bitcoin contribution to claimed daily compounding returns, supporting S03 as secondary. The displayed balances and claimed bonuses do not establish actual payouts.
